chunks: But they will never wish for death because of what they had done in the past, and God knows the sinners well.
ai.seo_question: Why do disbelievers desire death but not permanently?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological torment of the disbelievers who crave death to escape the consequences of their sins, yet hesitate due to the heavy burden of their accumulated deeds. It underscores Allah's omniscience regarding the unjust, serving as a warning that their delay in repentance is not due to ignorance but to the weight of their own actions.
